title: 第3章 ?续命项目
content_zh:
第3章续命项目
那些老人很迫切，他们时光无多，没有岁月可以耽搁，急需研究出成果。
所以，旧术实验班选择的都是高校学生，而非从孩童开始，前者年龄大一些，悟性更强。
散术都出自旧土，那些组织、研究机构认为，从源头恢复旧术研究，或许是最好的选择。
最为重要的是，既然所有神话传说等都源自旧土，这里或许有什么“神秘因子”也说不定。
只是这种认知与绚烂的深空科技文明相悖，不能列在纸面上。
但是，一些身份背景惊人的老人到了晚年后，似乎尤其信这些神秘学。
他们所求的是什么？更久远的寿命，希冀从神话中挖掘，沿着前人的足迹追寻到不死之路等。
尽管冷静时他们自己也知道，这多半是梦幻泡影，可如果时光无多，而自身又掌握有庞大的资源等，为什么不去试试呢？
所以，旧土开始被关注，一些“研究”相继在此展开，投入大量的资金。
人性自古相通，从秦皇开始到现在，许多人都不能免俗。
这些年来，一些财阀中的老人一直在推动，想要获得“新生”，资助了很多研究机构。
当然，旧术研究只是他们关注的方向之一，有实力去推动“生命变革”的人，不可能将希望只寄托在一项研究中。
长年以来，各大财阀资助过各种基因团队、生命研究所等，有些项目已经取得惊人的进展。
比如数种抗衰老药剂，已有了初步的成效。
旧术研究只是他们所投资的数十个“续命项目”之一。
其实这些“续命项目”彼此间也有交集，尤其是在投资人的干预下，有时会相互合作。
比如，王煊他们平日的食物，补血益气，养精神，且有部分抗衰效用，其中的成分与配比等都与一家药剂研究所有关。
旧术实验班的人平日消耗心神过重，但无论多么疲累，经过食补等配合，很快就能恢复过来。
对于每天都在研究与演练旧术的人来说，这是福音，一段时间过后他们的体质都有明显的提升。

此外，有些生物基因团队也希望合作，主动找上门来，想从基因方面入手，帮助实验班的人改变体质。
其中一支基因队伍专注于线粒体的研究，通过改变端粒的长度，理论上可以达到增加寿命的效果。
当时所有人都抵触，虽然号称是旧术实验班，但他们不是小白鼠，绝不会同意那样做。
王煊得到消息后，险些直接退出，无论如何他都不会接受。
他精研体术，琢磨冥想法，研究采气术等，是一个循序渐进改变体质的过程。
在他看来，这种基因工程粗暴的改变现状，可能会留下不可弥合的隐患，与他观念不相符，非他所求。
事实上，这项合作很快就被上面否决了，说话有分量的人开口，认为技术还不够成熟。
事后有小道消息传出，来自新星的学生中有些人身份不简单，他们的家人不可能让他们冒险。
同时，也是一位有背景的同学意外透露，新星那边有些“状况”，有人在旧术上练出了名堂，所以，他们这些人才赶到旧术发源地，甘愿深入参悟。
但事后他不承认，说那些都是醉话。
王煊觉得，他可能说漏嘴了。
但秦诚却相信，那就是醉话，因为当天就是他灌醉了那位同学。
王煊认为新星那边或许发现了什么，所以某些财阀的后人才会加入实验班，开始研究旧术。
此刻明月高挂，在深秋中略带冷意。
秦诚接了个电话，不断点头，而后转身对王煊叹道：“当年，周坤不是醉话啊，他确实说漏嘴了。”
在电话中，他得到最新消息，新星那边近期出现的一鳞半爪的传闻，有了模糊的指向，似乎与几起神秘现象有关。
早在三年前，那位来自新星的同学周坤就给予了他们提示！
尽管是因为醉酒，并非他本意想告知。
“你一定要获取一个前往新星的名额！”秦诚道，然后告别，转身离去。
身为旧术研究班的学生，他们的宿舍区较为安静，因为平日需要冥想以及练体术等，不容打扰。

每人都有独立的房间，且被提供由深空送来的特殊食物，可以说“旧术研究”这个项目很受重视。
清晨，王煊起床，演练一种名为金刚拳的体术后，安静下来，开始迎着朝霞练采气术。
按照老教授的说法，采气术、冥想、内养法等，必须精通一两种，这是旧术根之所在，力量的源头。
体术，比如形意、金刚等，都是根之上的枝叶，唯有根系强，才能枝繁叶茂。
王煊自然无比重视，对所有“根法”都有涉猎，后来更是有选择的精研。
校园这片区域大树较多，草坪上满是黄叶，此时很宁静。
王煊闭着眼睛，沐浴朝霞，他在采气，结合内养法，心中想象着接引来一缕又一缕金色霞光，将自己淹没。
虽是内养法，存想于心中，但他的身体似乎真的发热了，感觉像是被金色光焰缭绕着。
如有人在附近，一定能看出王煊身上的一些异常，他身上的朝霞比别人“浓郁”，像是有一层火光在流动。
王煊一边采气，一边动用内养法，虽然只是在心中存想接引金霞的样子，但现实中似乎真的在发生。
他周身滚热，最后更是酥酥麻麻，有一股劲力在身上钻，先是酸痛，而后又觉得很舒服。
他这种异样的感受，是在近期才出现的。
王煊知道，由于常年练采气术，并结合内养法，他现在开始“收获”。
昨天夜里，他的右手猛力按下去，直接在粗大而坚硬的树干上留下清晰的手印，就是“根法”逐渐有成的体现。
在旧术这条路上，他有了长足的进步。
实验班中，秦诚、周坤等人虽然也都在练旧术，但大多都只是体质提升了，像王煊这般采气入体，内养己身，算是仅有。
秦诚、周坤等如果对上普通人的话，一个人能对抗十几人没问题。
常年练旧术以及长期服食稀珍药膳，让他们的身体素质提升了一大截。
王煊在没有采气前，就已经比同窗强很多。
所以，秦诚一直为他鸣不平，如果单以旧术对抗的话，根本没有人能够与王煊并论。

甚至，他仅动用一只手，应该就可以压制旧术实验班中的任何一位同学。
王煊身体滚热，到了后来甚至有些发烫了，从血肉到骨骼，似有一道道细小的电流在经过。
这是采气、内养有了一定火候的体现。
王煊在心中存想一缕缕朝霞进入身体，而后又存想体内有黑色浊雾自体表散发出去。
以此对应，他的身体出现异常，新陈代谢加快，身上排出一些黏糊糊的汗液，湿漉漉。
他觉得，血肉像是在被朝霞洗礼，内外澄净，精气神异常充沛，全身充满了力量。
清晨的阳光穿过树林，让几缕薄雾都带上淡金色彩，四名年轻男女散步走来，两名男子只是偶尔说上一两句话，主要是两名女子在谈论着什么。
其中一名女子非常靓丽，一直在说话，不时发出笑声，一看就是活泼跳脱的性格。
另外一名女子很柔美，有种书香气韵，带着温和的笑。
他们也是旧术实验班的学生，来自新星。
“你们看，那不是王煊吗，他的身体怎么像是在发光？”青春活力十足的那个女子开口，漂亮的眼睛睁得很大，怀疑自己是否看错了。
那个有些文静的女子讶然：“他该不会练成采气术了吧？”
两位男子中的一人很吃惊：“实验班中……竟然真的有人练成了！”
但很快他又摇了摇头，因为他知道，现在这些已经失去意义。
另一名男子也开口：“可惜，旧时代的术终究是过时了，现在被正式放弃了，不久后我们就要回新星了，那边又有了新发现，把握住机会，新的时代可能要来了。”
几人来自新星，都了解最新内情，旧术被认为过时了，已经被抛弃，现在有了更好的选择！
恍若隔世的感觉，规则都变了，新书期间就可以投月票了，请大家支持下吧。
下午、晚上还有章节。
content_en:
Chapter 3 Life Extension Project
Those old people are very urgent. They don't have much time and no time to waste. They urgently need to research and produce results.
Therefore, the old art experimental classes only select college students, rather than starting from children. The former are older and have stronger understanding.
Sanjutsu all comes from the old soil. Those organizations and research institutions believe that restoring the research on old techniques from the source may be the best option.
The most important thing is that since all myths and legends originate from the old land, there may be some "mysterious factor" here.
It’s just that this kind of cognition is contrary to the splendid deep space technological civilization and cannot be listed on paper.
However, some old people with astonishing backgrounds seem to particularly believe in these mystical theories in their later years.
What do they want? For a longer lifespan, we hope to explore it from myths and follow the footsteps of our predecessors to pursue the road to immortality.
Although they themselves know when they are calm, this is probably a fantasy, but if they don't have much time and they have huge resources, why not give it a try?
Therefore, the old soil began to receive attention, and some "research" was carried out one after another, and a large amount of money was invested.
Human nature has been interconnected since ancient times. From the beginning of Emperor Qin to the present, many people are not immune to vulgarity.
Over the years, some old chaebols have been pushing for a "new life" and have funded many research institutions.
Of course, the research on ancient techniques is only one of the directions they focus on. People who have the strength to promote "life change" cannot pin their hopes on just one piece of research.
Over the years, major chaebols have funded various genetic teams, life research institutes, etc., and some projects have made amazing progress.
For example, several anti-aging agents have already achieved preliminary results.
Research on ancient techniques is just one of the dozens of “life-sustaining projects” they have invested in.
In fact, these "life extension projects" also overlap with each other, especially with the intervention of investors, and sometimes cooperate with each other.
For example, Wang Xuan's daily food nourishes blood, nourishes qi, nourishes the spirit, and has some anti-aging effects. The ingredients and proportions are related to a pharmaceutical research institute.
People in the old technique experimental class are usually too exhausted and mentally exhausted, but no matter how tired they are, they can recover quickly with food supplements and other combinations.
This is good news for people who study and practice old techniques every day. After a period of time, their physical fitness will be significantly improved.
In addition, some biological genetic teams also want to cooperate and come to our door. They want to start from the genetic aspect to help the people in the experimental class change their physiques.
One of the genetic teams focuses on the study of mitochondria. By changing the length of telomeres, one can theoretically increase lifespan.
At that time, everyone resisted. Although it was called an experimental class for old techniques, they were not guinea pigs and would never agree to do that.
After Wang Xuan got the news, he almost quit directly. He would not accept it no matter what.
He studied physical skills intensively, pondered meditation methods, studied Qi collection techniques, etc. It was a step-by-step process of changing his physique.
In his opinion, this kind of genetic engineering that violently changes the status quo may leave unsurmountable hidden dangers, which is inconsistent with his ideas and is not what he wants.
In fact, this cooperation was quickly vetoed by the higher-ups, who thought the technology was not mature enough.
Later, rumors spread that some students from Xinxing had unusual identities, and their families would not allow them to take risks.
At the same time, a classmate with a background accidentally revealed that there was some "situation" over at Xinxing, and someone had become famous in the old skills. Therefore, these people rushed to the birthplace of the old skills and were willing to understand them deeply.
But he refused to admit it afterwards and said those things were just drunken words.
Wang Xuan felt that he might have spilled the beans.
But Qin Cheng believed that it was drunken talk, because he was the one who got the classmate drunk that day.
Wang Xuan thought that Xinxing might have discovered something, so some descendants of the chaebol wereWill join the experimental class and start studying old techniques.
The bright moon is hanging high at the moment, a bit chilly in the late autumn.
Qin Cheng answered the phone, nodded repeatedly, then turned to Wang Xuan and sighed: "Back then, Zhou Kun wasn't drunk, he did let it slip."
On the phone, he got the latest news. There were vague rumors about Xinxing recently, and they seemed to be related to several mysterious phenomena.
As early as three years ago, Zhou Kun, a classmate from Xinxing, gave them a tip!
Although it was because he was drunk, it was not his intention to tell him.
"You must get a place to go to Xinxing!" Qin Cheng said, then said goodbye and turned to leave.
As students in the old arts research class, their dormitory area is relatively quiet, because they need to meditate and practice physical skills on weekdays, so they cannot be disturbed.
Each person has a separate room and is provided with special food sent from deep space. It can be said that the "Old Technique Research" project is taken very seriously.
In the early morning, Wang Xuan got up and practiced a physical technique called Vajra Boxing. Then he calmed down and began to practice Qi gathering techniques in the morning glow.
According to the old professor, one must be proficient in one or two of the techniques of Qi collection, meditation, internal cultivation, etc. This is the root of the old technique and the source of its power.
Physical arts, such as Xingyi, Vajra, etc., are all branches and leaves above the root. Only when the root system is strong can the branches and leaves flourish.
Wang Xuan naturally attached great importance to it and dabbled in all "root methods". Later, he selectively studied it intensively.
There are many big trees in this area of ​​the campus, and the lawn is full of yellow leaves. It is very peaceful at this time.
Wang Xuan closed his eyes and bathed in the morning glow. He was collecting Qi and combined it with the internal cultivation method. He imagined in his mind that one golden glow after another would flood him.
Although it was an internal cultivation method and kept in his mind, his body seemed to be really heated, and he felt like he was surrounded by golden flames.
If someone is nearby, they will definitely be able to see something abnormal about Wang Xuan. The morning glow on his body is "richer" than others, as if there is a layer of firelight flowing.
While Wang Xuan was collecting Qi, he was using the internal cultivation method. Although he was just trying to attract Jin Xia in his mind, it seemed to be really happening in reality.
His whole body was hot, and finally it became numb and numb. There was a strong force in his body. He felt sore at first, and then felt very comfortable.
His strange feeling only appeared recently.
Wang Xuan knew that he was now beginning to "harvest" due to his years of practicing Qi collection techniques and combining them with internal nourishment methods.
Last night, he pressed hard with his right hand, leaving clear fingerprints directly on the thick and hard tree trunk, which was a manifestation of the gradual success of the "root method".
He has made great progress on the road of old skills.
In the experimental class, although Qin Cheng, Zhou Kun and others are also practicing old techniques, most of them have only improved their physical fitness. Wang Xuan is the only one who can take Qi into the body and nourish it.
If Qin Cheng, Zhou Kun and others faced off against ordinary people, they would have no problem fighting against more than a dozen people.
Year-round practice of old skills and long-term consumption of rare medicinal foods have greatly improved their physical fitness.
Wang Xuan was already much better than his classmates before he had any Qi.
Therefore, Qin Cheng has been complaining about him. If he only fights with old skills, no one can compare with Wang Xuan.
In fact, he should be able to suppress any student in the old technique experimental class with just one hand.
Wang Xuan's body was hot, even a little hot in the end. From his flesh and bones to his bones, there seemed to be tiny electric currents passing through him.
This is a manifestation of a certain degree of heat for gas collection and internal cultivation.
Wang Xuan imagined in his mind that wisps of morning glow entered his body, and then imagined that black turbid mist was emanating from his body.
In response to this, his body became abnormal, his metabolism accelerated, and his body excreted some sticky sweat, making it wet.
He felt as if his flesh and blood were being baptized by the morning glow, making him pure inside and outside, his energy and spirit were extremely abundant, and his whole body was full of strength.
The morning sun shines through the woods,The few wisps of mist were given a light golden color, and four young men and women walked over. The two men only occasionally spoke a word or two, mainly the two women were talking about something.
One of the women was very beautiful. She kept talking and laughing from time to time. At first glance, she had a lively and out-of-the-box personality.
The other woman was very soft, with a scholarly charm and a gentle smile.
They are also students in the old arts experimental class, from Xinxing.
"Look, isn't that Wang Xuan? How does his body seem to be glowing?" The youthful and energetic woman opened her beautiful eyes wide, wondering if she had seen it wrong.
The somewhat quiet woman was surprised: "Isn't he capable of practicing Qi collection?"
One of the two men was surprised: "Someone in the experimental class...actually succeeded!"
But he soon shook his head again, because he knew that these had no meaning now.
Another man also spoke: "Unfortunately, the techniques of the old era are outdated after all, and are now officially abandoned. We will return to Xinxing soon, and there are new discoveries there. Seize the opportunity, a new era may be coming."
Several people are from Xinxing, and they all know the latest inside information. The old techniques are considered outdated and have been abandoned. Now there are better choices!
It feels like a world away. The rules have changed. You can vote monthly during the new book period. Please support me.
There are also chapters in the afternoon and evening.
